title: wildmat DP algorithm: O(n*m) worst-case with wall-clock test for adversarial input
description: wildmat.rs uses a DP algorithm (not backtracking regex) for RFC 3977 wildmat pattern matching. This prevents ReDoS: O(n*m) worst-case is guaranteed by the DP table. The adversarial test (repeated * with dense text) confirms sub-millisecond performance. This is the correct choice for a pattern match that runs on every GROUP/NEWNEWS/NEWGROUPS command.
